# BuildGrid UI

> React component library built on Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui primitives (Radix UI). Provides ~50 low-level components and ~15 composite blocks for building accessible, dark-mode-ready UIs in TypeScript.

## Key resources

- [Component manifest](./components-manifest.json): Machine-readable index of every component and block — check this first before reading source files. Contains exports, variants, props, ARIA roles, and composition patterns.
- [Developer guide](./CLAUDE.md): Conventions, file structure, and code patterns for adding/modifying components.
- [Storybook](https://adrianomaringolo.github.io/buildgrid-ui): Live visual documentation with interactive examples for every component.
- [Source components](./src/components/): Low-level primitives.
- [Source blocks](./src/blocks/): Composite higher-level components.
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history with breaking changes.

## Architecture

Components and blocks live in separate directories and are distinct concepts:

- **Components** (`src/components/`): Single-purpose primitives, usually thin wrappers around Radix UI primitives styled with Tailwind CSS v4. Each component is in its own subdirectory with `.tsx`, `.stories.tsx`, `.test.tsx`, and `index.ts`.
- **Blocks** (`src/blocks/`): Composite components that combine multiple primitives into a self-contained feature (e.g. `DataTable`, `PaginatedItems`, `Sidebar`, `FileUploadDropzone`). Same file structure as components.
- All components and blocks are barrel-exported from `src/components/index.ts` and `src/blocks/index.ts` respectively.
- Path alias: `@/` resolves to `src/`.

## Code patterns

- Class merging: `cn()` from `@/lib/utils` (wraps `clsx` + `tailwind-merge`)
- Multi-variant components: `cva()` from `class-variance-authority`
- Every color token requires a `dark:` Tailwind counterpart
- Every root element carries `data-slot="..."` for external styling hooks
- `'use client'` directive only when hooks or browser APIs are used
- Prop types via `React.ComponentProps<typeof Primitive.X>` — not manual re-declaration
- `className` prop always accepted and forwarded

## Component selection guide

Prefer the more specific component when one exists:

| Need | Use | Not |
|---|---|---|
| Interactive data grid with search/sort/filter/pagination | `DataTable` block | `Table` component |
| Paginated list of any items | `PaginatedItems` block | Manual pagination |
| Pagination UI bar | `PaginationControls` block | `Pagination` primitives |
| Destructive confirmation | `AlertDialog` | `Dialog` |
| Side panel / drawer | `Sheet` | `Drawer` (unless you need swipe gesture) |
| Toast notifications | `Toaster` + `toast()` from sonner | Any custom solution |

## Common composition patterns

### Paginated data grid (client-side)
```tsx
import { DataTable, DataTableColumn } from '@/blocks/data-table'

const columns: DataTableColumn<Row>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Status', cell: (row) => <Badge>{row.status}</Badge> },
]
<DataTable data={rows} columns={columns} />
```

### Paginated data grid (server-side)
```tsx
<DataTable
  data={currentPageRows}
  columns={columns}
  serverPagination={{
    currentPage,
    totalPages,
    totalItems,
    onPageChange: setPage,
  }}
/>
```

### Paginated custom list
```tsx
import { PaginatedItems } from '@/blocks/paginated-items'

<PaginatedItems data={allItems} perPage={20} emptyState={<EmptyItems notFoundText="No results." />}>
  {(items) => items.map((item) => <Card key={item.id}><CardContent>{item.name}</CardContent></Card>)}
</PaginatedItems>
```

### Form with validation feedback
```tsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>Edit profile</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardContent className="space-y-4">
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <Label htmlFor="name">Name</Label>
      <Input id="name" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
    </div>
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <Label htmlFor="role">Role</Label>
      <Select value={role} onValueChange={setRole}>
        <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="Select role" /></SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent>
          <SelectItem value="admin">Admin</SelectItem>
          <SelectItem value="viewer">Viewer</SelectItem>
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>
    </div>
  </CardContent>
  <CardFooter className="gap-2">
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button onClick={onSave}>Save</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

### Destructive action confirmation
```tsx
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="destructive">Delete account</Button>
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Are you absolutely sure?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>This action cannot be undone.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleDelete}>Delete</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
```

### Side panel with form
```tsx
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger asChild><Button>Edit</Button></SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">
    <SheetHeader><SheetTitle>Edit item</SheetTitle></SheetHeader>
    {/* form fields */}
    <SheetFooter>
      <Button onClick={onSave}>Save</Button>
    </SheetFooter>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>
```

### Toast notifications (set up once)
```tsx
// Root layout
import { Toaster } from '@/components/toaster'
export default function Layout({ children }) {
  return <>{children}<Toaster /></>
}

// Anywhere in the app
import { toast } from '@/components/toaster'
toast.success('Saved!')
toast.error('Failed to save.')
```

### Tooltip (provider once, use many)
```tsx
// Root layout or subtree root
<TooltipProvider>
  <App />
</TooltipProvider>

// Any component inside
<Tooltip>
  <TooltipTrigger asChild><Button size="icon"><TrashIcon /></Button></TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent>Delete item</TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>
```

## Anti-patterns to avoid

- Do NOT use `<Table>` primitives for interactive data grids — they have no built-in search, sort, or pagination. Use `<DataTable>` block.
- Do NOT build custom pagination state — use `<PaginatedItems>` or `<DataTable>` with `serverPagination`.
- Do NOT nest `<TooltipProvider>` — place it once at app root or a common ancestor.
- Do NOT use `<Dialog>` for destructive confirmations — use `<AlertDialog>` which has the correct `role="alertdialog"`.
- Do NOT use `<Drawer>` when you just need a side panel — `<Sheet>` is simpler. `<Drawer>` adds swipe-gesture support (via vaul) which is only needed for mobile-first UIs.
- Do NOT add `'use client'` to components that don't use hooks or browser APIs — it disables server-side rendering for the entire subtree.
- Do NOT use inline styles — Tailwind utilities only.

## Adding a new component

Every new component requires four files:
```
src/components/<name>/
  <name>.tsx          # implementation
  <name>.stories.tsx  # Storybook stories
  <name>.test.tsx     # unit tests with describe blocks: Rendering, Variants, Accessibility, Interaction, Edge Cases
  index.ts            # export * from './<name>'
```
Then add `export * from './<name>'` to `src/components/index.ts` (alphabetical order) and update `components-manifest.json`.
